name: oracle-lake-fl
description: Oracle property-intelligence web application for Lake County, Florida.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @oracle-lake/shared run build && pnpm --parallel --filter @oracle-lake/server --filter @oracle-lake/ui run dev
scripts.serve: pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:design
scripts.lint:county: eslint --no-ignore --no-warn-ignored pipeline/bin pipeline/infra pipeline/scripts/lake pipeline/src/batch pipeline/src/counties/lake pipeline/src/core/car.mjs pipeline/src/core/cid.mjs pipeline/src/core/artifact-manifest.mjs pipeline/src/core/gateway-verify.mjs pipeline/src/core/run-history.mjs pipeline/src/core/publish-gate.mjs pipeline/src/core/secondary-pin.mjs
